title: Nanoplastic concentration in human brain tissue (micrograms per gram)
geography: United States (Univ. of New Mexico decedent cohort)

source.name: Bioaccumulation of microplastics in decedent human brains
source.publisher: Nature Medicine (Nihart et al., Univ. of New Mexico)

notes: Median nanoplastic mass concentration measured in human frontal-cortex brain tissue from autopsy samples: about 3,300 micrograms per gram in 2016 vs about 4,900 micrograms per gram in 2024, roughly a 50% rise, per the peer-reviewed 2025 Nature Medicine study.
